item.title: Europe's wave of anger: How far will youth-led protests go?
item.description: Youth-driven protests have been popping up all over Europe: in Belgium, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Albania, Serbia and Greece. The spark here in France was deteriorating conditions in high schools and universities, particularly for students from underprivileged backgrounds. Meanwhile, wages aren't keeping up with inflation. The housing crisis is front and centre in places like Spain and Portugal, while corruption and democratic backsliding have sparked uproar in Albania and Serbia.
item.dc:creator: François PICARD

item.title: Manchester United blown out of the water by Como in Champions League rout
item.description: Michael Carrick's side saw their winless run extend to seven matches in all competitions as a Nico Paz double powered the Italian side to an emphatic 4-1 win on Wednesday night.
item.dc:creator: L'Equipe TV

item.title: Ukraine’s Pavlohrad refuses to yield to Putin despite unrelenting bombardment
item.description: In Pavlohrad, a Ukrainian city less than 90km from the front line with Russia, there is no respite from war. Residents describe daily life under bombardment, caught between exhaustion and determination. Amid criticism of Trump, TikTok rumours and strikes against civilians, FRANCE 24 gathered accounts from those who “refuse to yield”.
item.dc:creator: Assiya HAMZA
